current_flow: Today the task grill binds to task_digest(task) - sha256 over write_scope, required_tests, verify_commands, acceptance_criteria - computed by the CALLER and passed as --task-digest; record_grill_from_json stores it verbatim as input_sha256, and require_task_grill (called by stage start via require_ready_task, and delegate) plus task_frontier_state recompute the same four-field digest and compare. Plan state and repository state are invisible to the binding: a plan edit or product commit between grill and stage start goes undetected.

criteria_map.contract, plan-body, and product-tree ch: test_grounding_digest_staleness_matrix drives each matrix row: contract field edit, plan body edit, product commit (stale) vs .factory-only commit, plans-only commit, plan assume append (fresh)
criteria_map.caller-supplied --task-digest is gone; g: test_task_digest_arg_is_removed_and_gates_rederive proves passing --task-digest errors with the derived-internally message and that recorder, stage start, and delegate agree on grounding_digest

new_abstractions: grounding_digest(root, task) in factory_lib - existing task_digest covers only four contract fields and cannot see plan or repository state; extending it in place would change stage measurement's task_sha256, which decision 0023 forbids re-baselining. Reversible: grill-binding only, one function, gates fall back to task_digest by revert.

product_tree_digest(root) in factory_lib - no existing helper hashes repository content state; head_sha alone would stale grills on evidence commits (the regrill treadmill both rescue models flagged). Hashes the index blob list (path+sha) excluding .factory/ and plans/; deterministic, no mtime.
